# CME P00 — Interactive Playground

Interactive 3D visualization of **Carrier Manifold Encoding (P00)** stack combinations across all carriers. Single-file app (`index.html`), zero build step, runs on **GitHub Pages**.

## Files

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `index.html` | Full app — served as the Pages entry point |
| `scripts/update-readme-embed.sh` | Rewrites the iframe block in this README from `git remote origin` |

Keeping `index.html` at repo root gives a clean Pages URL (`github.io/repo/`). You can rename to `cme-playground.html` if you prefer an explicit filename, but then set that file as the Pages entry or link to it directly.

## GitHub Pages

1. Push this repo to GitHub.
2. **Settings → Pages → Source:** Deploy from branch `main`, folder `/ (root)`.
3. URL: `https://<username>.github.io/CME-Playground/`
4. Refresh the README embed: `./scripts/update-readme-embed.sh`

## Local preview

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
# open http://localhost:8080
```

Must use HTTP (not `file://`) for ES module imports.

## Developer notes

- **Self-test:** open DevTools → 17 sanity checks on load; `✅ All sanity checks passed` when every check passes.
- **Performance:** console warns when **N > 2000** (instanced meshes + tubes get heavy).
- **Mobile:** canvas uses `touch-action: none` so orbit gestures don't scroll the page.
- **Paper link:** set `PAPER_URL` at the top of the `<script>` block in `index.html` when the preprint is out.

## Rendering

- **InstancedMesh** icosahedra — crisp opaque dots, no blurry GL_POINTS overlap
- **EdgesGeometry** carrier outline — clean wireframe
- No fog, no transparency blending on trajectory dots
